name: Naluzotan
summary: Naluzotan (INN, USAN; PRX-00023) is a serotonergic drug of the phenylpiperazine class that was under investigation by EPIX Pharmaceuticals Inc for the treatment of generalized anxiety disorder and major depressive disorder. It acts as a selective and potent 5-HT1A receptor partial agonist, readily stimulating prolactin responses, though it has also been found to bind to and activate the σ receptor.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people outside clinical trials. Drugs of its kind, which activate the 5-HT1A receptor, commonly cause dizziness, nausea and headache.
sideEffects.zh: 除臨床試驗外，對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同類活化 5-HT1A 受體的藥物，常見副作用為頭暈、噁心與頭痛。
sideEffects.zhHans: 除临床试验外，对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同类活化 5-HT1A 受体的药物，常见副作用为头晕、恶心与头痛。

fact.en: It belongs to the phenylpiperazines, a chemical family that also includes the antidepressant trazodone and the anxiety drug buspirone's relatives.
fact.zh: 它屬於苯基哌嗪類，這個化學家族也包括抗憂鬱藥曲唑酮等藥物。
fact.zhHans: 它属于苯基哌嗪类，这个化学家族也包括抗忧郁药曲唑酮等药物。
